acceptance: RUBRIC 1 append: a progress note can be added to context without resending the existing text, with a test
RUBRIC 2 docs: defer's summary limit and the done-item restriction appear in the tool schema or description
context:
Imported on 2026-10-28 from the BenchBox tracker item(s): todo-db-context-update-replaces-shared-guardrails-20261023. Those items stay open in BenchBox to track the dependency.

Source context (todo-db-context-update-replaces-shared-guardrails-20261023): NOTE 2026-10-24 (Advisor review): confirmed against the live MCP schema - update_item has plain `context?: string|null` with no append operation, and defer.summary documents no length limit. The fix belongs to the todo-db project, not BenchBox; keep as a tracking item until todo-db ships it.
description:
On 2026-10-22, updating item context with a progress note (update_item with context) replaced the field and removed the COMMON GUARDRAILS C1-C10 block from 15 batch items; they were restored by hand from the original specs. There is no append mode, and nothing warns that a large field is being replaced by a much shorter one. Related friction in the same session: defer is refused on a done item, so the order finish-then-defer silently loses the deferral; the deferral summary has an undocumented 200-character limit (not in the tool schema).

CHANGE: add an append/prepend option for text fields (or a separate note operation), and document field limits and lifecycle restrictions in the tool schemas.
